You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. Do NOT run a formatter on YAML or markdown. You own only: storygame/runtime/*.py; data/stories/continuity-initiative/{handoffs.yaml,knowledge.yaml,storylet-routes.yaml,storylets.md,plot.md,world.yaml}; files under tests/; bench/affordance_known_gaps.json; scripts/ringer/affordance/3c_cue_gate_probe.py. Edit nothing else. Stay story-agnostic in storygame/runtime: no scene id, fact id or story name in runtime code (AGENTS.md "Forbidden Patterns"). Before touching world.yaml read docs/world-model-grounding.md. Write the narrator-facing text only from /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.plans/chatgpt-3c-structure-and-cues-answer.md (copy it unchanged; do not reword cues or plot sentences).

GOAL. Scene 3C (the last scene) must show a cue for each step of its chain, and steps C and D must each need BOTH of their two reveals. Today (a) cue staging is switched off in resolution scenes, (b) the cue code only reads bridge_events, and 3C has only resolution_events and no deliveries, so no cue ever stages, and (c) storylets SL-3C-C and SL-3C-D each hold two alternative reveals and fire on the FIRST one, after which the sibling reveal is no longer a candidate (knowledge.py _candidates skips a reveal whose source.storylet_id is in fired_event_ids). A probe already proves (b): run `uv run python scripts/ringer/affordance/3c_cue_gate_probe.py /tmp/probe.json` and read it.

DESIGN (build exactly this).
1. Runtime, cue staging in resolution scenes. In storygame/runtime/engine.py, the `_escalation_eligible()` block in the turn path covers both cue staging and Deadline (handoff) staging. Make CUE staging run in every scene, including resolution. Keep Deadline/handoff staging (`staged_handoff_fact_ids`) off in resolution scenes as now. Update the comment above it.
2. Runtime, cue source for resolution scenes. `_bridge_delivery_fact_ids()` reads only bridge_events and returns at the first unsatisfied one. Keep that behavior for bridge events unchanged. Add: when the scene has resolution_events, also return the delivered facts (facts that have a FactDelivery) which the scene's unfired, unsatisfied resolution_events still lack, in event order, without duplicates (use activation.minimal_undelivered_facts). Bridge events keep priority: if a bridge event yields facts, return those as today. Cue ranking and `_cue_reveal_available` then order the cues by themselves. Check `_bridge_missing_fact_ids` and the other readers of bridge events (engine.py lines near 493-600) and keep them consistent; do not change behavior for scenes without resolution events.
3. Storylet split in data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml (and the mirror text in storylets.md; keep both consistent, and update the 'new_fact_ids' / 'used_by_storylets' lists and any storylet id lists that name SL-3C-C or SL-3C-D, lines near 328-371, 492-504, 540, 2264-2380, 2706, 2733, 2773):
   - SL-3C-C keeps only realization R1 (pumps and tunnel). Add a new storylet for the surface gates with the same scene, activation, pacing and pressure role as SL-3C-C, one realization (the old SL-3C-C-R2). Pick an id that passes the loader pattern, for example SL-3C-C2 (if the pattern forbids it use SL-3C-F). Its title: use the old R2 wording, for example 'Open the Surface Gates'.
   - SL-3C-D keeps only realization R1 (detention-site reports, sets national_network_fragmenting). Add a second storylet for the families (old R2, sets community_rescue_efforts_begun), same scene, activation and pacing as SL-3C-D; id for example SL-3C-D2.
   - R1 of C asserts evacuation_route_open ONLY (remove captives_reaching_surface). R2 of C (gates) asserts los_angeles_facility_lost ONLY (remove captives_reaching_surface). Change the matching `establishes` of k_sl_3c_c_r1 and k_sl_3c_c_r2 in knowledge.yaml, and their storylet_id / realization_id to the new storylet ids, and fix their 'aliases' lists so they no longer name captives_reaching_surface.
   - Resolution events: resolution_escape gets realization_storylets [SL-3C-C, <gates storylet>] and activation all_facts_true [truth_no_longer_containable, evacuation_route_open, los_angeles_facility_lost]; it still produces captives_reaching_surface and los_angeles_facility_lost. resolution_network_consequences gets realization_storylets [SL-3C-D, <families storylet>]. resolution_complete gets realization_storylets with both new storylets and all_facts_true gains evacuation_route_open, los_angeles_facility_lost and community_rescue_efforts_begun (every cue fact must be named by some unsatisfied resolution event so the cue code can see it). Keep event order. Reveals d_r1 and d_r2 still require truth_no_longer_containable and captives_reaching_surface, so they unlock only after both C parts. E already waits on charles_at_large, which resolution_network_consequences produces, so E waits on both D parts; verify this and say so in notes.md.
   - Required-storylet checks (storygame/story_package/obligations.py is NOT yours, do not edit it): the new storylets are required because the resolution events list them. Fix any loader validation failure by editing story data, not the loader. If a loader rule truly blocks the design, stop and describe it in notes.md instead of weakening a rule.
4. Cues in handoffs.yaml: add the seven deliveries from the answer file, replacing each FILL fact_id with: cue_a -> truth_no_longer_containable; cue_b -> rebecca_captured; cue_c_pumps -> evacuation_route_open; cue_c_gates -> los_angeles_facility_lost; cue_d_reports -> national_network_fragmenting; cue_d_families -> community_rescue_efforts_begun; cue_e -> phase_two_conflict_plan_known. Copy the YAML shape of the existing 3B entries.
5. Pointers in knowledge.yaml: remove the final sentence of delivery_text from k_sl_3c_c_r1, c_r2, d_r1, d_r2 exactly as the answer file lists. Keep the pointers on a_r1, a_r2, b_r1, b_r2.
6. plot.md: add the five sentences from the answer file at the places it names. Do not remove the two 3C.4 sentences already there.
7. world.yaml: add the emergency_surface_gates item and the 3C item_ids and item_placements from the answer file, after reading docs/world-model-grounding.md. If the loader or the narration leak scan rejects a name, report it in notes.md rather than renaming it yourself.

TESTS. Create tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py with at least 7 test_ functions, hermetic (no live worker), commands in the imperative player voice (AGENTS.md 'Writing Player Input'). Use the helpers in tests/test_resolution_cascade.py as a model. Cover: (1) with the real engine in 3C the staged/ranked cue fact is truth_no_longer_containable at entry, then rebecca_captured after step A, then evacuation_route_open or los_angeles_facility_lost after B, only the missing C part after one C part, community_rescue_efforts_begun or national_network_fragmenting after C, only the missing D part after one D part, and phase_two_conflict_plan_known last; (2) c_r1 then c_r2 are both earnable in either order, and captives_reaching_surface becomes true only after both; (3) the same for d_r1 and d_r2, and E's reveals are not eligible until both D parts are done; (4) cue staging in a resolution scene does not set staged_handoff_fact_ids before the deadline; (5) scenes other than 3C behave as before (an existing cue test is enough); (6) the command table: for every row of the 'Player commands' table in the answer file, `uniquely_matched_candidate` (storygame/runtime/candidate_matcher.py) over the ten 3C reveals' action_evidence returns the stated reveal, or None; build the candidates the way the engine does; (7) no 3C cue contains the words JANUS, Phase One, Phase Two or coded message. Update existing tests whose assertions pin the old behavior (for example tests/test_markdown_story_package.py::test_bridge_required_player_safe_facts_have_one_self_conveying_delivery, tests/test_resolution_cascade.py, tests/test_cue_text_safety.py and bench/affordance_known_gaps.json); change an assertion only where the new design requires it, keep its intent, and list every changed assertion in notes.md. Never delete a test or weaken a safety assertion (the first-turn cue safety test must pass for all seven new cues; if a cue is rejected, report the word and the test in notes.md instead of editing the cue).

HOW TO CHECK. `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q` (about a minute; the full suite must pass), then `uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .` (ruff must not touch YAML or markdown). Also rerun the probe: `uv run python scripts/ringer/affordance/3c_cue_gate_probe.py /tmp/probe.json`; update the probe so it no longer patches the gate (the gate is now open for cues) and so it shows the cue source at each stage; the 3C entry stage must now list truth_no_longer_containable.

OUTPUT. Write notes.md at the worktree root: files changed, the final storylet ids, each changed assertion, how E's gating works, and anything you could not satisfy.
